title: Camera firmware versions MV 6.0 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Thu, 06 Jun 2024

New: Added support for Custom CV Webhooks
Bug fixes: Resolved an issue where cameras with motion-based retention alongside restricted bandwidth mode can disable motion detection
Resolved an issue where MV13/MV33/MV63(x)/MV93(x) can reboot when wireless profiles are enabled
General: Improved Color Matching for Attribute Search on MV13/MV63(x)
Improvements to MT sensor connectivity performance with MV gateways

Camera firmware versions MV 6.0 changelog

New

  • Added support for Custom CV Webhooks

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue where cameras with motion-based retention alongside restricted bandwidth mode can disable motion detection
  • Resolved an issue where MV13/MV33/MV63(x)/MV93(x) can reboot when wireless profiles are enabled

General

  • Improved Color Matching for Attribute Search on MV13/MV63(x)
  • Improved Object Tracking on MV13/MV63(x)
  • Improvements to MT sensor connectivity performance with MV gateways
